svg.aria-label: Sender (in focus): Submits or retries messages. Gateway (in focus): Holds client connections. Recipient (in focus): Reads new and missed messages. Chat service (in focus): Orders writes. Message store (in focus): Durable history. History backs reconnects. Delivery queue (in focus): Durable delivery events. Delivery worker (in focus): Routes stored messages. Connection directory (in focus): Finds live gateways. Find live gateway. Flow: Sender to Gateway: Send message. Gateway to Chat service: Forward send. Chat service to Message store: Store + sequence. Chat service to Delivery queue: Emit delivery event. Delivery queue to Delivery worker: Consume event. Delivery worker to Connection directory: Find gateway. Delivery worker to Gateway: Send to gateway. Gateway to Recipient: Push online update.
